---
title: "da_history_wide"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(googlesheets4)

da_summary <- read_sheet("1VDkll0kkTn8QaSx7b8mdDGPdZs3VMIt-XVFfQyqhGtM", sheet = "History of DA Statuses")
```

```{r widen_summary}
#| echo: false

wide_summary <- 
  da_summary %>% 
  select(`County Name`, `LEA Name`, `Report Year`, 
         `Student Group`, Description) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Report Year", values_from = "Description")

write_sheet(ss = "1VDkll0kkTn8QaSx7b8mdDGPdZs3VMIt-XVFfQyqhGtM",
            sheet = "History of DA Statuses - Wide",
            data = wide_summary)
```
